description: Use when the user wants a weather-disruption event triaged end-to-end: assess impacted passengers, handle the highest-priority PNR, then complete compliant re-accommodation with approval and traveler notification.
content:
## Canonical trigger
Re-accommodate passengers impacted by a weather cancellation.

## 1. impact_flow
Assess the disruption, segment passengers, and surface the highest-priority queue.

## 2. reaccommodation_flow
Retrieve passenger context, policy constraints, and ranked recovery options for the selected PNR.

## 3. resolution_flow
Hold the recommended option, request approval when required, then complete ticketing, hotel/voucher actions, and notification.
trigger_conditions: Flight TA217 has been cancelled due to weather. Re-accommodate impacted passengers.
A weather cancellation hit a transatlantic flight. Rebook the highest-priority passengers.
Handle this disruption and protect affected travelers.

steps.description: handler:impact_flow | Assess the disruption and prioritize impacted passengers
steps.content: Summarize the cancellation, group the impacted passengers, and identify the highest-priority handling queue.
steps.expected_output: A disruption summary with passenger queues and a recommended hero PNR.

steps.description: handler:reaccommodation_flow | Build passenger-specific recovery options for the selected PNR
steps.content: Load the selected passenger profile, policy constraints, and rank the top recovery options.
steps.expected_output: A recommended option with approval flags and rationale.

steps.description: handler:resolution_flow | Execute the approved recovery plan and notify the traveler
steps.content: Hold the recommendation, request approval if needed, then complete ticketing, hotel or voucher actions, and notification.
steps.expected_output: A final recovery outcome with approval status and action summary.
